info.about: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is a 1998 fighting video game developed and published by Capcom, based on Hirohiko Araki's manga of the same title. It was originally released for arcades on the CP System III (CPS-3) board; this version was known outside Japan as JOJO's Venture.
info.trivia: The Dreamcast version includes both the original arcade game and its revised Heritage for the Future update in their original forms.
info.why: The Dreamcast disc carries both arcade versions, and Capcom's 2012 HD port of this version was sold only as a download, so the disc is the only way to own it physically.
